Dear All,

Please be informed that the accommodation time period starts on 24 Septembe=
r until 26 September 2025.

We strongly advise you to come during that period so that you can get a pla=
ce in the Residence hall.
Also, after that you can come and sign the contracts for studies, thank you=
.


Best Regards,
Ms. Adina Petrescu
International Relations Officer
Centre for International Relations
Erasmus, International Cooperation and Foreign Students Office
"1 Decembrie 1918" University of Alba Iulia
5 Gabriel Bethlen Street, 510009 Alba Iulia, Romania
Phone: + 40 258 802814, + 40 258 806042
relint@uab.ro;
url:www.uab.ro<http://www.uab.ro/>
